class.name: FilesManifestServer
class.brief_description: Registers, edits, validates, saves and watches file manifests by name.

method.name: add_extension
method.description: Adds an extension to the manifest [param name] (normalized to lower case with a leading dot). Returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if it is already there.

method.name: add_file
method.description: Adds a single file to the manifest [param name]. The path is stored in its canonical form. Returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if it is already there.

method.name: add_folder
method.description: Adds a folder to the manifest [param name]. The path is stored in its canonical form. Returns [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if it is already there.

method.name: create_missing_folders
method.description: Creates the folders of the manifest [param name] that do not exist. Read-only paths (such as [code]res://[/code] in exported builds) are skipped with an error, and [constant ERR_FILE_NO_PERMISSION] is returned.

method.name: get_manifest
method.description: Returns the manifest registered as [param name], or [code]null[/code] with an error.

method.name: get_manifest_names
method.description: Returns the names of all registered manifests, sorted.

method.name: get_paths
method.description: Returns the file list of the manifest [param name]. The list is cached and rebuilt after every change of the manifest; call [method refresh] to read the folders again.

method.name: has_manifest
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a manifest is registered as [param name].

method.name: is_watching
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the folders of the manifest [param name] are watched.

method.name: poll
method.description: Reads the folders of all watched manifests again and emits [signal file_added] and [signal file_removed] for the differences. Called automatically every [member watch_interval] seconds when the main loop is a [SceneTree].

method.name: refresh
method.description: Reads the folders of the manifest [param name] again and updates the cached file list. If the manifest is watched, the differences are reported as signals.

method.name: register_manifest
method.description: Registers [param manifest] as [param name]. An existing manifest with the same name is replaced (its watching state is kept).

method.name: register_manifest_file
method.description: Loads the [FilesManifest] at [param path] and registers it as [param name]. [method save_manifest] without a path writes back to this file.

method.name: remove_extension
method.description: Removes an extension from the manifest [param name]. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if it is not there.

method.name: remove_file
method.description: Removes a single file from the manifest [param name]. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if it is not there.

method.name: remove_folder
method.description: Removes a folder from the manifest [param name]. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if it is not there.

method.name: save_manifest
method.description: Saves the manifest [param name] through [ResourceSaver] to [param path] ([code].tres[/code], [code].res[/code], or [code].json[/code]/[code].ini[/code] with the text formats). Without [param path], the file it was loaded from or last saved to is used.

method.name: set_watching
method.description: Starts or stops watching the folders of the manifest [param name]. While watching, added and removed files are reported with [signal file_added] and [signal file_removed].

method.name: unregister_manifest
method.description: Removes the manifest registered as [param name] from the server. The resource itself is not changed.

method.name: validate
method.description: Checks the manifest [param name] and returns a [Dictionary] with [code]missing_folders[/code], [code]missing_files[/code] and [code]unknown_extensions[/code] (extensions no resource loader recognizes), each a [PackedStringArray], and [code]valid[/code] ([code]true[/code] if all three are empty).

members.member: Seconds between two automatic polls of the watched folders.

signal.name: file_added
signal.description: Emitted when a file appears in a folder of the watched manifest [param name].

signal.name: file_removed
signal.description: Emitted when a file disappears from a folder of the watched manifest [param name].

signal.name: manifest_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the manifest [param name] was registered or edited through the server.
